claims.statement: The museum guide describes two wooden wheels from a cart used in the fourth century BCE at Doogarrymore, associated with a trackway.

evidence.note: Dating retained at century precision: 400–301 BCE. The source does not establish a lifespan or continuous use.

sources.title: Guide to the National Museum of Ireland: Archaeology
sources.creator: Eamonn P. Kelly, National Museum of Ireland (2007)
